sheets.title: Automatic Sprinkler Installation Plan - Home2Suites, Eagle Pass, Texas, 1st Floor (PDF page 1 of 4)
sheets.howConfirmed: Read the Fire Sprinkler Shop Drawings PDF itself. It is a 4-page Texas Fire Services LLC submittal, sheets FP-1..FP-4 in page order. PAGE 1 = FP-1, printed title "AUTOMATIC SPRINKLER INSTALLATION PLAN HOME2SUITES, EAGLE PASS, TEXAS, 1ST FLOOR" with "1ST FLOOR PROTECTION 18,183 SQFT / TOTAL AREA PROTECTED 72,732 SQFT", sheet stamp "FP-1", City of Eagle Pass Fire Department stamp, Triun Construction/Engineering title block. So first-floor guestroom sprinkler heads are on PAGE 1. Remaining pages: p2=FP-2 (2nd floor + pump room cross-section), p3=FP-3 (3rd floor), p4=FP-4 (4th floor + the two 6" standpipes). CAVEAT: this PDF's text layer is poor-quality OCR of a scanned shop drawing - the sheet titles and area callouts are legible but individual head tags/room numbers are not text-extractable, so per-room head counts must be read visually off page 1.

sheets.title: Fire Alarm System Layout, 1st & 2nd Floor Plan (PDF page 3 of 4)
sheets.howConfirmed: Read the Fire Alarm Shop Drawings PDF itself. It is a 4-page Security Integrated, Inc. submittal. Page 1 (FA-0) carries a printed SHEET / DRAWING TITLE schedule: FA0 = cover/project info/sheet schedule; FA1 = installation notes, scope, equipment schedule, operation matrix, calcs; FA2 = "FIRE ALARM SYSTEM LAYOUT, 1ST & 2ND FLOOR PLAN"; FA3 = "FIRE ALARM SYSTEM LAYOUT, 3RD & 4TH FLOOR PLAN". PAGE 3 is the FA-2 sheet and its own page text contains both "FIRE ALARM FLOOR PLAN - 1st Floor" (rooms 101-118, 141, STAIR 1 100, GUEST CORRIDOR 121, plus "Provide smoke detector, typ.") and "FIRE ALARM FLOOR PLAN - 2nd Floor" (rooms 201-241). So first-floor guestroom fire alarm devices are on PAGE 3, sheet FA-2 - note that one sheet covers floors 1 AND 2. Page 4 = FA-3 (3rd floor 301-341 and 4th floor 401-440).
